About Al Jalila Children’s Specialty Hospital

Al Jalila Children’s Specialty Hospital, located in Al Jaddaf, Dubai, is a pioneering healthcare institution dedicated exclusively to providing advanced medical care for children. Established as a gift by Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum to the children of the UAE in celebration of the first birthday of his daughter Al Jalila, the hospital opened its doors in 2016. This visionary project reflects a deep commitment to enhancing pediatric healthcare and offering world-class medical services in the region.

With a state-of-the-art facility spanning over 200 beds, Al Jalila Children’s Specialty Hospital is designed to provide comprehensive care to young patients in a compassionate, child-centered environment. The hospital is equipped with cutting-edge medical technology, advanced diagnostics, and specialized treatment areas that cater to a wide range of pediatric conditions, including complex surgeries and chronic illnesses.

The hospital’s expert team includes internationally trained doctors, specialists, nurses, and healthcare professionals who are dedicated to ensuring the health and well-being of children. They provide high-quality care across a variety of pediatric specialties, including pediatric surgery, neurology, cardiology, oncology, neonatology, orthopedics, pulmonology, and gastroenterology, among others.

Al Jalila Children’s Specialty Hospital stands as a beacon of hope for children and their families, offering:

  • Cutting-edge technology: The hospital uses the latest medical equipment and tools, including pediatric
  • patients and their families, including:
  • Multidisciplinary teams: The hospital employs a holistic approach by bringing together specialists from various disciplines to work collaboratively in treating complex medical conditions, ensuring the best possible outcomes for young patients.
  • Pediatric Emergency Care: The hospital operates a 24/7 Pediatric Emergency Department, equipped with the latest diagnostic tools and a dedicated team trained to handle urgent cases with speed and accuracy.
  • Family Support Services: The hospital understands the emotional and psychological challenges that families face during a child’s treatment. To support families, Al Jalila Children’s Specialty Hospital offers counseling, therapy services, and a support network for parents and caregivers.
  • Educational Programs: Recognizing the importance of continued learning, the hospital offers educational resources for parents and children alike. This includes information on managing specific medical conditions, child health tips, and preventive care strategies to enhance long-term health.
  • International Collaboration: Al Jalila Children’s Specialty Hospital has developed partnerships with global healthcare institutions, ensuring that the latest research, treatments, and procedures are available for children in the UAE. The hospital collaborates with leading specialists from around the world, bringing international expertise to local care.
  • Advanced Research: The hospital is not only focused on treatment but also medical research in pediatric care. It supports clinical trials and the development of innovative therapies, contributing to the global pediatric medical community.
  • Specialized Pediatric Services: The hospital offers a wide range of services tailored to the needs of children, including:
  • Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) for premature and critically ill newborns.
  • Pediatric Cardiac Surgery and care for congenital heart conditions.
  • Pediatric Oncology for children fighting cancer, with state-of-the-art chemotherapy and support services.
  • Rehabilitation Services for children recovering from injuries or surgeries, including physiotherapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy.
  • State-of-the-Art Surgical Facilities: The hospital boasts advanced pediatric surgical suites, designed to provide the safest, most efficient surgeries for children. These facilities are equipped with the latest technology, allowing for minimally invasive surgeries whenever possible.
  • Telemedicine Services: The hospital offers telemedicine consultations for families who are unable to visit the hospital in person. This enables access to world-class pediatric care remotely, bringing convenience and accessibility to patients across the UAE and beyond.
  • Dedicated Pediatric Units: Each specialty area in the hospital is tailored specifically to the needs of children. The hospital’s pediatric units are designed with child-friendly equipment, beds, and spaces to ensure that children feel comfortable and supported throughout their hospital stay.
  • Awards and Recognition: Since its opening, Al Jalila Children’s Specialty Hospital has been recognized for excellence in pediatric care, earning accolades for its high standards in patient safety, quality of care, and innovative treatments.

At Al Jalila Children’s Specialty Hospital, every aspect of care is designed with one goal in mind: the well-being of children. Whether it’s treating a life-threatening condition, providing routine pediatric care, or offering post-treatment rehabilitation, the hospital is committed to being a trusted partner in every child’s health journey.

We are more than just a hospital; we are a sanctuary of healing and hope, where children receive the best possible medical care with a compassionate, family-centered approach.

About Al Sharq Hospital – Fujairah

Al Sharq Hospital – Fujairah is a premier healthcare institution located in the heart of Fujairah, United Arab Emirates. As part of the Al Sharq Healthcare Group, a division of Fujairah National Group (FNG), Al Sharq Hospital has been committed to delivering high-quality healthcare services for nearly two decades. With a strong legacy of providing exceptional care, the group has become one of the most trusted healthcare providers in the eastern region of the UAE.

State-of-the-Art Facilities

As the first and only JCI accredited 100-bed premium private hospital in Fujairah, Al Sharq Hospital offers advanced medical care and emergency services. The hospital is equipped with modern medical technologies, ensuring the highest standard of care for both inpatient and outpatient needs. Some of the standout facilities include:

  • 21 Outpatient Departments: Offering a wide range of medical specialties and services, ensuring comprehensive care for every patient.
  • Emergency Care: A 7-bed, 24-hour Accident & Emergency Unit, equipped with the latest technology to manage critical cases.
  • Advanced Diagnostic Equipment: Including a 256 Slice CT Scan, Open MRI, Mammography, 4D Ultrasound, Fluoroscopy, and more.
  • Operating Theatres: Four fully equipped operating theatres for a variety of procedures.
  • Maternity Services: A self-contained maternity complex with four delivery rooms and five Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) beds.
  • ICU and NICU: A sophisticated 5-bed Intensive Care Unit for adults, as well as a dedicated paediatric bed for ventilatory management.
  • Medical Imaging and Laboratory: Cutting-edge imaging equipment, including MRI, CT scan, and Ultrasound, alongside a highly advanced medical laboratory that offers services such as immuno-haematology, hormone assays, and microbiology.

Comprehensive Care Services

Al Sharq Hospital is committed to providing a wide array of medical and surgical specialties, ensuring that patients receive evidence-based, accurate care tailored to their needs. Some of the key services include:

  • Emergency and Critical Care: The hospital’s 24-hour Accident & Emergency Unit ensures that critical cases are handled efficiently and with the highest care standards.
  • Endoscopy Suite: A purpose-built suite for diagnostic and therapeutic gastroenterological procedures.
  • Mother & Child Department: Exclusive care dedicated to the well-being of mothers and children.
  • Dialysis Unit: A specialized dialysis unit offering cutting-edge treatments.
  • Surgical Services: Comprehensive surgical specialties, with well-equipped operating rooms and highly skilled surgical teams.

Patient-Centered Approach

Al Sharq Hospital prides itself on its patient-centered care, focusing on comfort, safety, and personalized treatment. The highly trained and experienced staff ensure that each patient receives individual attention, tailored care plans, and the latest treatment options.

Commitment to Quality and Affordability

Al Sharq Hospital has consistently strived to provide high-quality healthcare while ensuring it is affordable and accessible. The hospital’s commitment to evidence-based medicine, paired with modern medical technologies, has redefined the healthcare landscape on the East Coast, positioning Al Sharq Hospital as a leading healthcare provider in the region.

Core Features of Al Sharq Hospital

  • 24/7 Accident & Emergency Unit with a team of highly trained emergency professionals.
  • Advanced Medical Imaging technologies, including MRI, CT scan, and ultrasound.
  • A comprehensive laboratory for specialized medical tests and diagnoses.
  • ICU and NICU services for critically ill patients and newborns.
  • Maternity Services including labor rooms and a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU).
  • Dialysis Unit, catering to patients requiring renal care.
  • Physiotherapy Services including diathermy, ultrasound therapy, and a gymnasium for rehabilitation.
  • Specialized Investigations for echo doppler studies, EEG, and urodynamic studies.

With these high-end services and an unwavering commitment to patient care, Al Sharq Hospital continues to set a standard of excellence in healthcare in Fujairah and the wider UAE.

Specialized Rehabilitation Hospital (SRH), based in central Abu Dhabi, is a purpose-built facility focused exclusively on rehabilitation care. It is affiliated with the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab in the United States (formerly the Rehabilitation Institute of Chicago), a global leader in rehabilitation.

SRH offers advanced services for patients recovering from serious injuries or medical conditions. Its Bayt Al Qudra™ House of Ability provides an environment that supports patients in regaining independence, mobility, and confidence after life-changing events.

The hospital houses 166 licensed beds and delivers a full continuum of care, including:

  • Inpatient and outpatient rehabilitation
  • Post-acute rehabilitation
  • Long-term care for adults and children
  • Ventilated long-term care with 24/7 ICU and HDU support

Care is delivered by specialized doctors, therapists, and clinical teams using the latest rehabilitation technologies, including robotics and bionics. Treatment plans are tailored to each patient’s needs, combining medical expertise with measurable outcomes.

SRH is the first facility in the UAE to offer both acute and long-term rehabilitation services under one roof, with a focus on quality, safety, and patient progress.

King’s College Hospital London – UAE is a premier healthcare provider, offering world-class medical services through its state-of-the-art 100-bed hospital located in Dubai Hills, Mohammed bin Rashid City, and its modern medical centers in Marina and Jumeirah. As part of the globally renowned King’s College Hospital network in the UK, the UAE branch delivers exceptional care that combines British clinical standards with local convenience.

Approximately one-third of the clinical leadership team, including all department heads, have been recruited directly from the UK, with extensive experience in the National Health Service (NHS). Most of the medical staff are UK-trained and bring decades of expertise in delivering evidence-based, patient-focused care.

Committed to treating patients of all ages and medical needs, King’s College Hospital Dubai offers comprehensive services ranging from consultations and diagnostics to advanced treatments and post-care support. In complex cases, patients may also be referred to the UK hospital for further specialized treatment.

Patient well-being is at the core of King’s operations. All clinical protocols in the UAE are modeled after the UK facility’s high standards, backed by over 175 years of medical excellence. This commitment ensures that patients in the UAE receive the same level of trusted care as those in London.

The hospital’s long-standing relationship with the UAE began in 1979, following a generous donation from the country’s founding father, His Highness Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, to support the development of the King’s Liver Research Centre—now one of the top three liver centers globally.

The Story of Eli Lilly and Company

For more than 150 years, Eli Lilly and Company has focused on improving lives through medical innovation, scientific research, and patient care.

The company was founded by Colonel Eli Lilly, who believed in continuously improving healthcare and helping communities through better medicines. His vision still guides the company today.

Over the years, Lilly has introduced important medical treatments, supported global health programs, and invested in research to solve some of the world’s biggest healthcare challenges.

Important Moments in Lilly’s History

1906 – Supporting Communities in Crisis

Lilly helped people affected by the San Francisco earthquake by replacing lost medical supplies at no cost.

1917 – Helping During World War I

Working with the American Red Cross, Lilly helped establish a medical field hospital in France to care for wounded soldiers during World War I.

1923 – Introducing the First Commercial Insulin

Lilly launched the world’s first commercially available insulin treatment for diabetes, giving hope to patients living with a disease that previously had very limited treatment options.

1940s – Advancing Antibiotic Production

Lilly became one of the first companies to mass-produce penicillin, helping fight infectious diseases around the world.

1955 – Polio Vaccine Distribution

The company helped manufacture and distribute the Salk Polio Vaccine globally, supporting efforts to protect millions from polio.

1961 – Cancer Treatment Innovation

Lilly introduced one of its first cancer medicines derived from the Madagascar periwinkle plant to help treat several forms of cancer.

1982 – A Breakthrough in Diabetes Care

Lilly launched Humulin®, the world’s first insulin made using recombinant DNA technology, closely matching the insulin naturally produced by the human body.

1986 – Depression Treatment

Lilly introduced Prozac®, a medicine used in the treatment of clinical depression, helping improve mental health care worldwide.

1996 – Expanding Mental Health and Cancer Treatments

The company introduced new medicines for schizophrenia and several types of cancer, continuing its focus on serious health conditions.

2000s – Global Health and Community Support

Lilly expanded programs supporting diabetes care, tuberculosis treatment, mental health awareness, and employee volunteer initiatives worldwide.

2018 – Diabetes Support Programs

The company launched the Lilly Diabetes Solution Center to help patients in the U.S. access insulin support and payment assistance.

2019 – Expanding Cancer Research

Lilly acquired Loxo Oncology to strengthen its cancer treatment research and innovation.

2020 – Fighting COVID-19

Lilly supported global COVID-19 response efforts by providing testing support, donating protective equipment, and developing antibody treatments.

2022 – New Diabetes Treatment

The company introduced Mounjaro®, an advanced treatment option for diabetes management.

2023 – Expanding Weight Management Treatments

Lilly launched Zepbound® for chronic weight management and expanded affordable insulin access programs.

2024 – Alzheimer’s Disease Innovation

The company introduced Kisunla®, its first treatment for Alzheimer’s disease, marking an important step in neurological care.

Lilly also launched LillyDirect®, a platform designed to improve patient access to healthcare services and treatments.

2025 and Beyond – Investing in the Future

Lilly announced major investments in new manufacturing and research facilities to help reach more patients globally and continue advancing medicine for future generations.

A Legacy of Care and Innovation

Today, Eli Lilly and Company continues to focus on discovering new medicines, supporting communities, and improving patient care around the world through science, compassion, and innovation.

GDPR Compliance and Data Privacy at Carestream Dental

At Carestream Dental, protecting customer and patient information is a top priority. As a global provider of dental and oral healthcare technology, we are committed to keeping personal data safe and secure. Our software and systems are built with strong security measures to maintain privacy and earn the trust of our customers.

Our Commitment to GDPR

Carestream Dental follows the requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), which protects the personal data and privacy rights of people in the European Union (EU) and the United Kingdom (UK). The GDPR came into effect on May 25, 2018 and applies to organizations that collect, manage, or process personal information of EU and UK residents.

We also work closely with our third-party vendors and service providers to make sure they follow GDPR standards as well.

Security and Data Protection

We use strict security policies and data management practices to protect personal information. A dedicated internal team, including a Data Protection Officer, oversees GDPR compliance across the organization.

Our policies and procedures are regularly updated to:

Protect personal data inside and outside the EU and UK
Improve security controls
Respond quickly and effectively in the unlikely event of a data breach

We only process personal data based on the instructions provided by our customers.

International Data Transfers

Because Carestream Dental operates globally, some personal data may be stored or processed outside the EU and UK, including in the United States or other countries where our offices, affiliates, or service providers operate.

When transferring personal data internationally, we rely on approved Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) to help ensure data remains protected according to GDPR requirements.

Data Retention

We keep personal data only for as long as necessary to:

Fulfill the purpose for which the data was collected
Meet legal or contractual obligations
Provide agreed services to customers and business partners

Once the data is no longer needed, it is securely deleted or archived according to applicable regulations.

Support for Practice Management Software and CS Connect Users

Our practice management software includes features that help customers comply with GDPR requirements, especially regarding security and patient privacy.

These features include:

User authentication and access controls to limit access to patient records
Security tracking for additions, edits, and deletions of records
Patient archiving tools that support the “right to be forgotten,” where legally allowed
Data anonymization when sending image files to laboratories through CS Connect
Secure remote support with encrypted access and customer approval before connection
Secure backup services through trusted third-party providers to improve system reliability and resilience

We continue to improve our software and services to support changing privacy and regulatory requirements.

Support for Imaging Customers

We understand that GDPR compliance can be challenging and time-consuming. To support our imaging customers, we are continuously enhancing our tools and systems with features that help:

Manage user access controls
Delete or anonymize user data
Monitor and audit data processing activities
Support data subject rights
Strengthen data security protections

Our goal is to make compliance easier so customers can focus more on patient care and daily operations.

Updates to This Statement

This GDPR Compliance Statement may be updated from time to time to reflect changes in laws, regulations, or company practices. Any important updates will be shared through notices on this page.

We encourage customers to review this information regularly to stay informed about our privacy practices.

Contact Us

Carestream Dental supports the core principles of GDPR and believes in using personal data fairly, transparently, and securely.

If you have questions or concerns about GDPR or data privacy, you can contact us at:

privacy@csdental.com

Privacy Policy

About This Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how Dr. Sabah Al Sakban Medical Center Abu Dhabi collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you use our website, mobile application, or medical services.

We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your information responsibly and securely.

Important Information

Some of the information you provide may include personal medical details, also known as Protected Health Information (PHI). This information is protected under UAE laws and healthcare regulations, including the laws and regulations of the Department of Health Abu Dhabi and the UAE Ministry of Health.

If there is any difference between this Privacy Policy and UAE healthcare laws, the UAE laws will always apply.

Information We Collect

Personal Information

  • Phone number
  • Home address

  • Billing information

Other Information

  • Reviews and feedback
  • Information you choose to share with us

We may also update or correct your personal information when needed to keep it accurate.

Information Collected Automatically

When you use our website or app, some technical information may be collected automatically, including:

  • Browser type
  • Device information
  • Operating system
  • Pages visited
  • Time and date of visits

We may use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience and help our website function properly.

Information from Third Parties

This information helps us improve our services and communicate with you more effectively.

How We Use Your Information

  • Process payments
  • Send important updates and service information
  • Improve customer support
  • Conduct internal research and analysis
  • Maintain safety, security, and legal compliance

We may also use non-personal information to improve our services and website performance.

Sharing Your Information

We respect your privacy and only share your information when necessary.

Service Providers

We may share information with trusted partners who help us operate our services, including:

  • Payment processors
  • IT and hosting providers
  • Customer support services
  • Marketing and analytics providers
  • Telemedicine service providers

These providers are only allowed to use your information to support our services.

Legal Requirements

We may share information if required by law, court orders, or government authorities to protect patients, staff, and public safety.

Business Changes

Your information may be transferred if the business is merged, sold, or reorganized.

We never use patient consultation or appointment information for marketing purposes.

Data Security

We use appropriate security measures to protect your personal and medical information from:

  • Unauthorized access
  • Loss or theft
  • Misuse
  • Alteration or disclosure

While we work hard to protect your information, no online system can guarantee complete security.

Your Choices

You may choose to:

  • Update or correct your personal information
  • Disable cookies through your browser settings
  • Limit certain types of data collection

Please note that disabling cookies may affect some website features.

We do not share your medical information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

Third-Party Websites

Our website or app may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those external websites.

Advertising and Tracking

You may choose to opt out of interest-based advertising through your browser or device settings. Even if you opt out, you may still see advertisements, but they may be less relevant to you.

Some browsers also use “Do Not Track” signals. At this time, our services may not respond to those signals consistently due to differences between browsers.

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact Dr. Sabah Al Sakban Medical Center Abu Dhabi directly.

About SAICO

SAICO has a long history in the insurance industry, with its roots dating back to 1952. Before the introduction of Saudi Arabia’s modern insurance regulations, the company operated cooperative insurance activities in the Kingdom through Saudi investors based in Bahrain.

Following the development of the Saudi insurance sector and the introduction of new insurance regulations, SAICO was officially established as a Saudi joint-stock company in 2007 under the approval of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. The company operates under the supervision of the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA).

At the time of its establishment, SAICO’s capital was SAR 100 million, divided into 10 million shares with a nominal value of SAR 10 per share. To support its growth and expansion plans, the company increased its capital to SAR 250 million in 2015 through a rights issue. In 2018, a further increase of SAR 50 million was made through bonus shares, bringing the total capital to SAR 300 million, divided into 30 million shares.

Prayatna UAE is a trusted child development center dedicated to supporting children and families across the United Arab Emirates. As the UAE branch of Prayatna Child Development Centre, we bring over 23 years of experience in pediatric therapy and developmental care, helping children reach their full potential through personalized and evidence-based treatment.

We understand that every child develops at their own pace. Our team of experienced therapists works closely with families to create individualized therapy programs that address each child’s unique strengths and developmental needs. By combining professional expertise with a caring and supportive approach, we help children build confidence, improve essential life skills, and achieve meaningful progress.

At Prayatna UAE, we believe that family involvement is an important part of every child’s journey. We work hand in hand with parents, providing guidance, education, and continuous support to help children thrive both at home and in everyday life.

To be one of the most trusted child development centers in the UAE, recognized for excellence in pediatric therapy, innovation, and family-centered care that empowers every child to grow with confidence and independence.

Speech Therapy
Occupational Therapy
Behavior Therapy
Physiotherapy
Autism Intervention Programs
Developmental Screening and Assessments

Our multidisciplinary team works together to create personalized therapy plans that support each child’s physical, emotional, social, and communication development.

Dr. Joseph Sunny founded Prayatna with a vision of making quality child development services accessible to every family. With decades of experience in pediatric therapy and child development, his leadership continues to guide the organization’s commitment to compassionate care, professional excellence, and continuous innovation.

Over 23 years of experience in child development and therapy.
Individualized treatment plans tailored to each child’s needs.

Professional, safe, and child-friendly environment.

Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, Diaverum is committed to helping patients live healthier, more fulfilling lives through high-quality, patient-centered care.

Its services include preventive kidney care, haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, home dialysis support, holiday dialysis, and coordinated care for patients with additional medical conditions. By focusing on personalized treatment plans, the company ensures that every patient receives compassionate and effective care throughout their healthcare journey.

Chronic Kidney Disease affects millions of people worldwide and continues to grow due to factors such as diabetes, high blood pressure, and other lifestyle-related conditions. Diaverum is dedicated to making its clinics safe, welcoming, and supportive environments where patients receive not only expert medical care but also respect, comfort, and encouragement.

Innovation is at the heart of Diaverum’s approach. About Ibrahim A. Badran Foundation (IBF)

Founded in 2014, the Ibrahim A. Badran Foundation (IBF) is a non-profit organization dedicated to providing quality healthcare to people who have limited access to medical services. We serve communities in remote and underserved areas across Egypt through medical convoys, fixed satellite clinics, and mobile health clinics.

Our clinics are equipped with the essential medical equipment and pharmacy services needed to provide safe and reliable care. With the support of experienced healthcare professionals and dedicated volunteers, we work to improve the health and well-being of the communities we serve.

Our Vision

Our vision is to ensure that everyone in Egypt has access to quality healthcare, regardless of where they live or their financial situation.

Our Mission

We are committed to delivering accessible, high-quality healthcare through our medical convoys and fixed and mobile clinics. We continuously improve our services by adopting modern healthcare practices while respecting every patient’s privacy, dignity, and individual needs.

Our Goal

Our goal is to reduce the gap in healthcare access by expanding our medical services to more communities across Egypt. We aim to strengthen and sustain our healthcare programs so that more people can receive the medical care they need.

Our Story

IBF was founded in memory of the late Dr. Ibrahim A. Badran, whose lifelong passion was helping people in need. He believed that healthcare is a basic right and dedicated his life to improving the lives of underserved communities.

Inspired by his vision, his family, friends, and colleagues came together to establish the Ibrahim A. Badran Foundation. Today, we continue his mission by bringing compassionate, quality healthcare to those who need it most.

Every patient we serve reflects our commitment to making healthcare more accessible and creating healthier communities across Egypt.

About Racing Analytical Laboratory (RAL)

Founded in 2009, the Racing Analytical Laboratory (RAL) is a government laboratory based in Al Wathba, Abu Dhabi, dedicated to promoting integrity, fairness, and excellence in animal racing through advanced anti-doping and diagnostic services. Since its establishment, RAL has played a vital role in supporting the UAE’s racing industry by ensuring that competitions are conducted according to the highest scientific and ethical standards.

Initially specializing in anti-doping testing for racing camels, RAL has continuously expanded its capabilities to meet the evolving needs of the country’s sporting and veterinary sectors. In 2019, the laboratory broadened its services to include anti-doping testing and diagnostic support for other racing animals, reinforcing its commitment to safeguarding the health and welfare of animals participating in competitive events.

Equipped with advanced laboratory technologies and supported by a team of skilled scientific professionals, RAL delivers accurate, reliable, and internationally recognized testing services. At ANIB, we believe that insurance is more than a policy—it’s a long-term partnership built on trust, transparency, and commitment. By combining local market expertise with innovative solutions and modern technology, we help our clients make informed decisions and confidently manage risk.

Our success is driven by a customer-first approach, continuous innovation, and a highly skilled team committed to delivering value, reliability, and peace of mind at every stage of the insurance journey.

Our Vision

Teamwork

CEO’s Message

Dear Partners and Healthcare Professionals,

Since 2012, JAT Medical has been working to support the development of healthcare in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region. We provide healthcare solutions across several specialties, including Urology, Andrology, Gastroenterology, Bronchology, Diabetes Care, and Medical Education.

We are proud to contribute to the development of a modern and patient-focused healthcare system in line with Saudi Vision 2030. Through strong relationships with international healthcare companies and local partners, we bring new technologies and solutions to healthcare professionals.

Our work is guided by quality, integrity, innovation, and genuine care for patients. We continue to look for new opportunities to improve healthcare services, support medical professionals, and provide solutions that can make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

As we move forward, we remain committed to growing together with our partners and customers and contributing to a healthier future for the communities we serve.

Our Journey

1985 – The Beginning

Our journey began in 1985 with Al Shamel Dental Clinics, a group of clinics and medical centres focused on providing professional dental care and treatment.

2004 – Entering Education

In 2004, we expanded into the education sector by establishing Riyadh Colleges of Dentistry & Pharmacy. It became the first health-related institution under the Ministry of Higher Education to receive accreditation from the National Commission for Academic Accreditation and Assessment (NCAAA).

Through years of hard work and continuous development, the institution grew into Riyadh Elm University (REU), now recognized as one of the leading private universities in the Middle East specializing in dental sciences.

2014 – Supporting Our Growing Needs

As the university continued to grow, we established Adad Al Ayam Co. in 2014 as a separate company to provide the university with medical materials, supplies, and equipment.

2019 – Expanding Dental Services

In 2019, we expanded our business into the dental services sector. We built a dedicated and professional sales team to serve customers and healthcare providers across Saudi Arabia.

2022 – Looking Ahead

Following the COVID-19 period, we focused on expanding our product portfolio and building partnerships with reputable international brands. Our goal is to continue bringing quality dental products and solutions to the Saudi healthcare market.

Moving Forward

Our journey has been built on experience, commitment, and continuous growth. As we look to the future, we remain focused on developing our services, strengthening our partnerships, and contributing to the growth of the dental healthcare sector in Saudi Arabia.

Our services are guided by evidence-based, neuroaffirming, and family-centred practices. We combine current clinical knowledge with compassionate and personalised care to create therapy that is engaging, meaningful, and tailored to each child and their family.

We understand that progress does not happen only in the therapy room. Meaningful development also takes place at home, in the classroom, on the playground, and throughout the community.

That is why we work in partnership with families, educators, and other professionals. We provide practical strategies and support that can be used in the environments where children learn, play, communicate, and grow.

At Sunshine Therapy, success is not measured only by major achievements. It is reflected in greater confidence, meaningful participation, growing independence, and the celebration of every milestone—big or small.

Because when children feel understood, they flourish. And when families feel supported, everyone shines.

Comprehensive Healthcare Services

General and Annual Health Checkups

Preventive healthcare plays an important role in maintaining long-term wellness. NVC Medical provides comprehensive health assessments and routine screenings to help identify common health concerns and support early intervention.

These assessments may include checks for:

  • Diabetes
  • Cholesterol levels
  • Liver and kidney function
  • Iron deficiency
  • Vitamin levels
  • Other important health indicators

Advanced Predictive Genetic Screening

The clinic offers advanced genetic screening using a saliva sample to provide insights into certain inherited health risks.

The screening may assess genetic predisposition to conditions such as:

  • Certain cancers
  • Parkinson’s disease
  • Dementia
  • Rheumatoid arthritis
  • Systemic lupus erythematosus
  • Other autoimmune disorders

It also includes nutrigenetic analysis, which may help individuals understand how their bodies respond to different foods and make more informed decisions about healthy aging and wellness.

These services are supported by local clinical interpretation and genetic counselling.

To create a future where the molecular causes of disease are better understood and every family in the region can access personalised genetic information to support better healthcare decisions.

A Note from Our Founders

Finding the right psychology practice is an important step toward better mental health. At Belle Vie, we understand that people need more than professional advice. They need a safe and welcoming space where they can speak openly, feel understood, and receive the support they deserve.

Life in Dubai can be exciting, but it can also bring unique challenges. Adjusting to a new culture, managing work pressure, maintaining relationships, and living away from family can sometimes feel overwhelming. Even when everything appears fine on the outside, people may be dealing with stress, anxiety, emotional exhaustion, or uncertainty in their personal lives.

We believe that feeling heard and understood can make a real difference. Everyone deserves the opportunity to explore their feelings without fear of judgment and to receive support that respects their individual experiences.

Our Story

Belle Vie was founded by Dr. Elif Celebi Adam, a clinical psychologist, and Dr. Jais Adam-Troian, a social psychologist and assistant professor at Heriot-Watt University Dubai. Based in the UAE, we bring together our experience in clinical psychology, academic research, and human behaviour to provide thoughtful, personalised mental health support.

Our work has helped us understand how personal experiences, relationships, cultural backgrounds, and everyday pressures can affect emotional well-being. We recognise that every person has a different story, and we believe that effective psychological care begins with listening and understanding those individual needs.

Belle Vie is a Dubai Health Authority (DHA)-licensed psychology practice located in Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT). Our goal is to create a supportive environment where individuals, couples, and families can seek professional help with confidence and feel comfortable throughout their journey.

We follow evidence-based psychological approaches and maintain a strong commitment to professional standards. Whether you are dealing with anxiety, low mood, burnout, relationship difficulties, or a major life change, our team is here to help you better understand your experiences and work toward meaningful progress.

We see therapy as a positive step toward self-awareness, emotional well-being, and a healthier way of living. Asking for help is not a weakness; it is an important part of taking care of yourself.

Who We Are

Belle Vie brings together a team of psychologists and a psychiatrist to provide a range of mental health services in one convenient location. Our aim is to make it easier for clients to access the right support based on their needs.

Our team includes professionals licensed by the Dubai Health Authority or the Community Development Authority. We also offer support in English, Arabic, Turkish, French, and Persian, helping clients communicate comfortably in the language they know best.

Our services include:

  • Individual therapy for adults experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, stress, and life transitions.
  • Couples therapy to help partners improve communication, understand one another, and work through relationship challenges.
  • EMDR therapy for people who may benefit from support in processing distressing experiences.
  • Child and adolescent therapy to support emotional, behavioural, and developmental needs.
  • Perinatal mental health support during pregnancy and the period following childbirth.
  • Psychiatric assessments and medication management when clinically appropriate.
  • Adult ADHD assessments to help individuals better understand their difficulties with attention, organisation, and daily functioning.

Each member of our team has specific areas of expertise. When you contact us, we can help you find a professional whose experience and approach best match your needs.

How We Work

We believe that psychological care should be personal, practical, and based on a clear understanding of each individual.

Appointments are 50 minutes long and are available in person at our clinic or online. Your journey usually begins with an initial consultation, during which your psychologist will listen to your concerns, learn about your background, and discuss what you hope to achieve.

Together, you will develop a plan that reflects your goals, preferences, and circumstances. Depending on your needs, your therapist may use approaches such as Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), EMDR, Schema Therapy, or the Gottman Method for couples.

We do not believe that one approach works for everyone. Our clinicians select suitable methods based on professional assessment, available evidence, and your individual needs.

We also understand the importance of coordinated care. If you already work with a general practitioner or psychiatrist, we can communicate with them when appropriate and with your consent. If a psychiatric assessment or additional support is needed during therapy, our in-house team can help you explore the available options.

Where We Are

Our clinic is located at HDS Business Centre, Office 403, Cluster M, Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai.

Paid RTA parking is available in Cluster M, including spaces outside the building and across from McDonald’s.

We welcome clients from across Dubai, including Dubai Marina, JBR, Palm Jumeirah, and Jumeirah. For those who prefer remote sessions or cannot visit the clinic, online therapy is also available across the UAE, subject to the relevant professional and licensing requirements.

Getting Started

Taking the first step toward therapy can feel difficult, especially if you are unsure what to expect. We aim to make the process as simple and comfortable as possible.

You can contact us by phone, WhatsApp, or through our website. Our team will ask a few questions about your concerns and help you find the most suitable clinician. We will then guide you through the booking process and available appointment times.

Sessions are paid directly to the clinic. Depending on your insurance policy and coverage, you may be able to submit a claim for reimbursement.

You do not need to have everything figured out before reaching out. We are here to listen, answer your questions, and help you understand your options.

What Our Clients Say

“Belle Vie is one of the most experienced psychology clinics in Dubai. The team’s academic background and professional approach are truly impressive.”

— Google Review

“The atmosphere is welcoming and incredibly calming. I felt heard, understood, and supported from my very first session.”

— Google Review

“I was always afraid to start therapy. The team was patient and understanding, and they gave me the time I needed to feel comfortable taking that step. Thank you to Belle Vie for your care and for not giving up on me.”

— Google Review

A Place Where You Can Feel Understood

At Belle Vie, we believe that everyone deserves compassionate care, professional guidance, and a space where they can feel comfortable being themselves.

Whatever you may be going through, you do not have to navigate it alone. We are here to support you as you work toward greater understanding, emotional balance, and a better quality of life.

Because everyone deserves a Belle Vie.

Azure Medical Clinics L.L.C. is a multidisciplinary healthcare center based in Abu Dhabi, dedicated to providing quality medical care in a comfortable, modern, and welcoming environment.

We believe that every patient deserves personal attention, compassionate support, and treatment they can trust. Our team of healthcare professionals combines medical expertise with a patient-focused approach to ensure that each individual feels comfortable, respected, and well cared for.

At Azure Medical Clinics, we understand that good healthcare is about more than treating illnesses. It is also about listening to patients, communicating clearly, building lasting relationships, and making every visit a positive experience.

Our clinic offers a range of medical services, including Dermatology, General Practice, General Dentistry, Orthodontics, and Gynecology & Obstetrics. With multiple specialties available under one roof, we aim to make healthcare more convenient and accessible for individuals and families.

We are committed to continually improving our services, investing in our team, and maintaining high standards of care. Our goal is to create a place where patients feel confident in their healthcare choices and receive the support they need at every stage of life.
